# Contact us

This web application was developed by the U.S. Fish & Wildlife Service, Division of Migratory Bird Management (Alaska Region), to serve as a central repository for avian data and analytical results relevant to the Lower Cook Inlet, Alaska. Please contact the [Alaska Migratory Birds Office](https://www.fws.gov/office/alaska-migratory-birds/contact-us) with any questions. Key project personnel, include:

**Jim Johnson**\
Wildlife Biologist - Alaska Landbird Coordinator

**Amy Pocewicz**\
Deputy Assistant Regional Director - Migratory Birds Management

**Zak Pohlen**\
Wildlife Biologist - Landbirds
